author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಒಡ್ಡುತಿರು ವಿಷಯ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳನು
ಅಂತೆಕಂತೆಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಸುಳಿಯದಿರು ನೀನು
ಮಂಥಿಸಿರೆ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ರತ್ನಗಳೇ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾವು
ಚಿಂತೆಯೊಗೆದಭ್ಯಸಿಸು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Keep laying your doubts and confusions before reflection;
do not go circling round rumour and hearsay;
churn a subject well, and gems may yet appear —
so cast off worry and study on, O deluded one.
en.note: ‘Churning’ recalls the churning of the ocean, which brought up precious gems.
en.bhavartha: Bring your doubts into the open and think them through, instead of living on rumour. Understanding comes from churning a question patiently, as the ocean was churned for its treasures. Put worry aside and keep studying.
